evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies httpserver, bitcoin-cli, and RPC bind/connect handling.
rationale: Adds UNIX domain socket support to the HTTP RPC server and bitcoin-cli, resolving issue #5029 open since 2014. This provides a long-requested interface capability that allows downstream tools to communicate with the node using filesystem permissions instead of TCP loopback and -rpcallowip configuration.
